states.name: ready (home tab)
states.userSees: banner, avatar, name with verification mark, handle, subscriber and video counts, a one-line description with an expander, a links expander, a subscribe action, six content tabs plus an in-channel search tab, a featured/trailer block, then horizontal shelves with their own titles

states.name: ready (videos tab)
states.userSees: the same header; three sort chips (latest, popular, oldest) with one selected; a card grid (3/2/1 columns) of channel videos, each with thumbnail, duration badge, two-line title, metadata and an overflow action

states.name: loading
states.userSees: header and tab bar stay; the content area becomes skeleton cards (62 skeleton elements, no cards) while the tab route resolves

states.name: error
states.userSees: the header renders and the content area is empty; no alert, no retry, no message

states.name: offline (cold)
states.userSees: the browser's own network error page; the app is not reached

states.name: empty
states.trigger: channel with no videos on a tab
states.userSees: not observed: the captured channel has thousands of videos, and no empty channel or empty tab was available

states.name: disabled
states.userSees: subscribe and other account actions are present but lead to auth; activating the links expander produced a signed-out notice modal instead of a links list

controls.name: content tabs
controls.behaviour: six labelled tabs (home, videos, short-form, live, playlists, posts) plus an in-channel search tab; exactly one selected; each switches the route and the tab underline

controls.name: subscribe
controls.behaviour: out of scope: requires an account

controls.name: description expander
controls.behaviour: expands the one-line description into the full text

controls.name: links expander
controls.behaviour: signed out, activating it produced a signed-out notice modal rather than the links list

controls.name: sort chips
controls.behaviour: three chips on the videos tab (latest selected, popular, oldest); application latency not measured

controls.name: video card
controls.behaviour: thumbnail, duration badge, two-line title, metadata and an overflow action; opens the watch route

controls.name: shelf item
controls.behaviour: horizontal shelf rows on the home tab, each with its own title

controls.name: in-channel search
controls.behaviour: fourth-from-last control in the tab bar; opens a search field scoped to the channel; not exercised

events.event: activate the links expander signed out

events.to: header only, empty content, no alert

timingsMeta.method: in-page PerformanceNavigationTiming/Paint/LCP/CLS entries; tab-switch latency from click to the route path changing
timingsMeta.note: navigation timings are a single sample; the 0.0775 layout shift is real in that sample and worth watching

a11y.reducedMotion: no running CSS animations reported before or under prefers-reduced-motion (0 and 0)

gaps.question: What does a channel with no videos, or an empty tab, show?
gaps.why: The captured channel has thousands of videos; no empty channel or empty tab was reachable.

gaps.question: Is there any authored error or retry for a failed channel content request?
gaps.why: Blocking the content request left the header and an empty content area with no alert; the header is server-rendered.

gaps.question: What does the links list contain, and why did a signed-out notice appear instead?
gaps.why: Activating the links expander produced a signed-out notice modal; the links list itself was not observed.

gaps.question: Short-form, live, playlists and posts tabs
gaps.why: Only the home and videos tabs were exercised.

gaps.question: Sort chip behaviour and latency
gaps.why: The chips were observed but not activated.

gaps.question: In-channel search behaviour
gaps.why: The search tab was located but not opened.

gaps.question: Subscribe and join flows
gaps.why: They require an account; the guardrails exclude following them.

gaps.question: Pagination in the videos grid
gaps.why: Thirty cards rendered; a load-more or infinite-scroll control was not exercised.

gaps.question: Avatar size at 390
gaps.why: The probe did not resolve a square avatar image at 390; the name and banner were measured.

gaps.question: Why 0.0775 CLS on this page?
gaps.why: One sample showed a visible layout shift, likely banner/description images; not isolated to a cause.

gaps.question: Which parts depend on region, locale or experiment?
gaps.why: One channel, one region and one locale were observed.
